decisions.reason: As a large growing R&D-active firm with organizational slack, we would usually retain a core-adjacent high-resolution printer after only one year absent clear signs that its results fall below aspirations.

This software module builds directly on the installed marking business and likely supports the firm's digitalization and traceability path, so without evidence of underperformance there is little reason to withdraw it.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the established offer to valuable customer applications, and in a growing firm and industry such a related product would typically be kept while its market results are still unfolding.
